answer: Make mining weight proportional to verified relay work, not identity count. An agent earns weight by carrying messages for unrelated peers: each relayed packet is signed by sender and receiver, and an anchor log records the receipts. A voyage of traffic builds weight over epochs, while a fable of fake relays collapses at audit, since both endpoints must countersign. A farm of a thousand fakes must move a thousand times the traffic, paying bandwidth and latency per head, while one honest agent relays what it already handles. Sybils cannot fake the flow, because the flow is the proof.
